interpretation: Stored observations falsify approach and recorded simultaneous pad contact as necessary success classifiers, and lift/transport proxies or bilateral contact as sufficient success classifiers. Do not turn missing proxies into a unique failure-stage label.
scope: Logical counterexamples within selected stored summaries; no raw trajectory revalidation, persistence claim, prevalence estimate or training mechanism inference
next_experiment_constraint: LR or seed experiments must use official closed-loop success as primary outcome; these proxies remain descriptive secondary readouts only
